metadata.description: Official Bright Data skills - web scraping, page fetching, search, browser automation, and billing for any coding agent

plugins.name: brightdata-plugin
plugins.description: Nine agent-first Bright Data skills: agent-onboarding (start here - install, log in once, route to the right skill), scrape (Web Scraper API and Scraper Studio for structured data, with free-discovery scripts), fetch (one URL through Web Unlocker as markdown, HTML, or a screenshot), search (SERP API, Google verticals, the top-100 job, and answer engines), browser (point Playwright, Puppeteer, or Selenium at the cloud browser), billing (balance, charges, and cost estimates), and the brightdata-cli, brightdata-mcp, and brightdata-sdk interface guides.
